title: chore!: require Node.js 26.9 (AI-assisted)
body:
## Breaking Changes

Node.js 26.9 or newer is now required; Node.js 24 and all versions below 26.9 are no longer supported. Upgrade local, CI, and hosting runtimes (for example, `nvm install 26.9 && nvm use 26.9`). See the [Node.js 26.9 release notes](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.9.0) and the updated installation requirements linked below.


## Motivation

v26 will become the LTS in October, so Docusaurus v4 should use it.

## Test Plan

- Formatting, ESLint pre-commit checks, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Validated all 38 changed engine ranges: reject Node 24, 25, and 26.8; accept 26.9 and newer.
- Parsed workflow YAML and verified all 3 Node matrices and 21 setup-node configurations.
- Verified create-docusaurus rejects the local Node 26.8.1 runtime with the updated requirement.
- Earlier in this task, `pnpm test` passed 184 files / 2,976 tests on Node 26.8.1. The final Node 26.9 changes have not been tested locally on 26.9; GitHub CI will validate both matrix entries.

### Test links

Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-12463--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/

- [Installation requirements](https://deploy-preview-12463--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/docs/next/installation)
- [GitHub Pages deployment](https://deploy-preview-12463--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/docs/next/deployment/github-pages)

## Related issues/PRs

None.
